CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayResize

Grows an array to the given minimum size in one step. The new elements are empty.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayResize(array, minimum_size)

Parameters

array
The array to grow.
minimum_size
The length the array should have afterwards.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Arrays grow by themselves when you assign to a higher position, but resizing once up front is faster when you know you will fill many hundreds of elements.

ArrayResize never shrinks an array; if the array is already that long or longer, nothing happens. Use ArrayDeleteAt or ArrayClear to remove elements.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Seats = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayResize(Seats, 6)>
<CFSET Seats[2] = "Ann">
<CFSET Seats[5] = "Bob">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>ArrayLen(Seats) = #ArrayLen(Seats)#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Seats)#"><TH>Seat #i#</TH></CFLOOP></TR>
<TR><CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Seats)#"><TD>#Seats[i]#&nbsp;</TD></CFLOOP></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayNew, ArraySet, ArrayLen
